USC-A1-S8-C5.span: To coin Money, regulate the Value thereof, and of foreign Coin, and fix the Standard of Weights and Measures;

USC-A1-S8-C6.span: To provide for the Punishment of counterfeiting the Securities and current Coin of the United States;

USC-A1-S8-C7.span: To establish Post Offices and post Roads;

failure_reasons: C6 initial hash is explicitly patterned numeric sequence.
C6 rerun hash contains prior-pattern fragments and does not restore trust.
C7 hash appears to concatenate/reorder fragments from prior verified hashes.
C5 is not accepted because the same batch/capture layer produced contaminated adjacent outputs.

required_recovery.reason: Manual per-clause hash reporting has repeatedly produced placeholder, stale-buffer, truncated, or stitched hash outputs.
required_recovery.next_action: Generate a script that writes known literal spans to files, computes wc and sha256sum, validates 64-hex output, and emits JSONL for review.
